Keyleth lights fire hands to illuminate; Kerrek and Percival gain better sight; bowl and door become visible; room features described.
Percival questioned about potential fire-based mechanism; intelligence roll 19; no visible mechanical system; door-seam appears very smooth.

Session: Basilisk blood trap in basilisk blood pool; blood drops poured earlier by party enable mechanism. Door opens after blood interaction; orb-like light sources trigger undead attack. Flame-skull encounter imminent. (turns 1451-1480)
Door to necromancer sanctum revealed after blood ritual; party gains radiant protection from Holy Aura; four flaming skulls materialize and advance. (turns 1481-1484)
Combat start: initiative rolled for flaming skull encounter; party members with high init include Scanlan and Vax; dynamics of brave frontline vs. support roles. (turns 1490-1515)

Encounter notes: Skulls swarm in from both sides; Moonbeam hit both skulls with 13 radiant damage each (failed saves). Scanlan and Vax acted first; Pike failed sentry rolls earlier. Invisible Scanlan positioned; Vax moved to opposite wall and attacked with daggers; two daggers hit, total 19 psychic + 10 physical damage.
Keyleth casts Moonbeam centered to affect both skulls on that side; both failed Con saves, taking 13 radiant damage total to each from beam; flame aura on skulls subsides briefly.
Pike initiative result 9; Kerr roll of 1 acknowledged; anchor-man term noted by DM; round order continuing with skulls advancing toward Pike and Kima.
